title: Multimodal examination answer data with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education rubrics for criterion-level assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.22346v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This data article describes a multimodal collection of scanned examination answers paired with expert-designed Outcome-Based Education (OBE) grading metadata. The collection contains 485 answer submissions from 415 consenting students at four academic institutions. Eight faculty contributors supplied examination materials covering nine subjects and 12 distinct question templates. Each answer-level item links a scanned PDF to a randomized identifier, subject label, question, model answer, criterion definitions, performance-level descriptions, criterion marks, and a total mark. The 12 rubrics contain 47 criteria in total. The scans retain realistic academic content, including handwriting, printed text, equations, tables, code, figures, sketches, and diagrams. translated_title: 多模态考试答案数据与专家设计的基于成果导向教育评分标准用于标准级评估
translated_abstract: 本文数据文章描述了一个多模态的扫描考试答案数据集，该数据集与专家设计的基于成果导向教育（OBE）评分元数据配对。该数据集包含来自四所学术机构的415名同意参与学生的485份答案提交。八位教师贡献了涵盖九个科目和12种不同问题模板的考试材料。每个答案级项目将扫描的PDF与随机标识符、科目标签、问题、模型答案、标准定义、表现水平描述、标准分数和总分关联起来。12个评分标准共包含47个标准。扫描件保留了真实的学术内容，包括手写、印刷文本、方程式、表格、代码、图形、草图和图表。CamScanner、Adobe Scan和传统扫描仪在光照、对比度、方向、压缩和分辨率方面引入了变化。多样化的手写、划掉的工作、修订痕迹和边缘注释增加了现实世界的复杂性。该数据集支持标准级评估、自动评分、文档分析、手写识别和基于成果导向教育的评估研究。
tldr: 该论文提供了一个包含485份多模态扫描考试答案和47个专家设计的OBE评分标准的数据集，用于支持标准级评估和自动评分研究。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multimodal dataset of 485 scanned exam answers with 47 expert-designed OBE rubrics, supporting criterion-level assessment and automated grading research.
